# Package server settings

This page is for administrators and developers who point an installation at a package server, or tune how it
downloads. It lists every key of `settings/package.ini [RepositorySettings]` in 6.0.15 with its default, says which
code reads it, and adds the two settings of `site.ini` that go with them.

## Contents

1. [The keys at a glance](#the-keys-at-a-glance)
2. [RemotePackagesIndexURL](#remotepackagesindexurl)
3. [RemotePackagesIndexURLBase](#remotepackagesindexurlbase)
4. [Further package servers](#further-package-servers)
5. [Vendor and RepositoryDirectory](#vendor-and-repositorydirectory)
6. [The download settings](#the-download-settings)

8. [Overriding the settings](#overriding-the-settings)

## The keys at a glance

```ini
# settings/package.ini (6.0.15)
[RepositorySettings]
RepositoryDirectory=packages
RemotePackagesIndexURL=https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15
RemotePackagesIndexURLBase=https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential
AdditionalRemotePackagesIndexURLs[]
RemotePackagesIndexSources[]
RemotePackagesIndexSources[]=ezupdate.ini;PackageServerSettings;Servers
Vendor=7x
DownloadAttempts=3
DownloadRetryDelays[]
DownloadRetryDelays[]=2
DownloadRetryDelays[]=5
DownloadRetryDelays[]=10
DownloadTimeout=300
DownloadConnectTimeout=30
```

| Key | Default | Read by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RemotePackagesIndexURL` | the 6.0.15 folder | setup wizard, kickstarter, `exp:install`, ezupdate, `exp:ezwebininstall` | the release folder whose `index.xml` is read |
| `RemotePackagesIndexURLBase` | `.../exponential` | the same, only when `RemotePackagesIndexURL` is empty; the wizard's "Additional packages" link | the top of the server |
| `AdditionalRemotePackagesIndexURLs[]` | empty | setup wizard, kickstarter, `exp:install` (6.0.15 on) | further servers, read after the main one |
| `RemotePackagesIndexSources[]` | ezupdate's list | the same | lists of further servers in other settings files |
| `Vendor` | `7x` | `eZPackage::systemRepositoryInformation()` | the repository folder of the installer's packages |
| `RepositoryDirectory` | `packages` | `eZPackage::repositoryPath()` | the folder of all package repositories below the storage directory |
| `DownloadAttempts` | `3` | `eZStepSiteTypes::downloadFile()` | how many times a download is tried |
| `DownloadRetryDelays[]` | `2`, `5`, `10` | the same | seconds to wait before each further attempt |
| `DownloadTimeout` | `300` | the same | seconds a whole download may take |
| `DownloadConnectTimeout` | `30` | the same (curl only) | seconds to wait for the connection |

## RemotePackagesIndexURL

The address of a **release folder**, without `index.xml`. `eZStepSiteTypes` appends `/index.xml` (or `index.xml`
when the value ends in `/`). The packages' own addresses come from the `url` attributes in that index, so they may
be on another host.

Each release of Exponential changes this value in its `package.ini` to its own folder; the history of the key is in
[History of the package server](history-of-the-package-server.md). The URL may use `https://` or `http://` for the
setup wizard; ezupdate accepts only `https://`.

The same value is shown, read only, as the first server on ezupdate's **Package servers** page, and is the default
of `exp:ezwebininstall` when its `--url` option is not given (`kernel/private/classes/commands/ezwebininstall.php`).

## RemotePackagesIndexURLBase

Used when `RemotePackagesIndexURL` is **empty**. The constructor of `eZStepSiteTypes` then builds:

```text
<RemotePackagesIndexURLBase>/<major>.<minor>/<version>/index.xml
```

with `<major>.<minor>/<version>` from `ExponentialSDK::packageServerPath()`: `6.0/6.0.15` for this release, with the
release state appended only for a release that is not stable (`6.0/6.0.16alpha1`).

> **Note**
> Fixed in 6.0.15. Before, the fallback called `ExponentialSDK::version()` with its defaults, which append the
> release state: the result was `6.0/6.0.15stable/`, a folder the server does not have (it answered `404`). From
> 6.0.15 on, the setup wizard builds `6.0/6.0.15/`, the folder the package server has, and so does ezupdate
> (`eZUpdatePackageServers::builtinIndexURL()`) from its release that ships with 6.0.15 on. Setting
> `RemotePackagesIndexURL` to the release folder you want is still the clearest choice.

The Site package step also links "Full archive of all packages can be found here" to this value.

## Further package servers

From 6.0.15 on, the setup wizard, the kickstarter and `exp:install` (all three read the index through
`eZStepSiteTypes::retrieveRemotePackagesList()`) read more than one server:

```ini
[RepositorySettings]
# folders with an index.xml, read after RemotePackagesIndexURL
AdditionalRemotePackagesIndexURLs[]
AdditionalRemotePackagesIndexURLs[]=https://packages.example.com/exponential/6.0/6.0.15
# lists of servers kept in other settings files: <file>.ini;<block>;<setting>, an array of <name>=<URL>
RemotePackagesIndexSources[]
RemotePackagesIndexSources[]=ezupdate.ini;PackageServerSettings;Servers
```

- The main server (`RemotePackagesIndexURL`, or its offline copy) comes first. A package an earlier index lists is
  kept as it is; a further server only adds the packages the earlier ones do not have.
- The default source is the list of ezupdate's **Package servers** page
  ([Package servers in ezupdate](../admin-gui/package-servers-in-ezupdate.md)), kept in
  `settings/override/ezupdate.ini.append.php`. Empty `RemotePackagesIndexSources[]` in an override to read only the
  servers named in `package.ini`.
- Only `http://` and `https://` addresses are read, each once. A further server that cannot be read is skipped with a
  warning in the debug output; the step shows an error only for the main server.
- A requirement is downloaded from whichever server lists it, so a site package on one server may require packages of
  another.

## Vendor and RepositoryDirectory

Packages are stored in `var/<StorageDir>/<RepositoryDirectory>/<vendor>/<name>/`, which with the defaults is
`var/storage/packages/7x/<name>/`. An imported package goes into the folder named by its own `<vendor>`; packages made
on the installation go into `local/`. `Vendor` names the **system repository**, the one the setup wizard looks into
for an offline `index.xml` (`var/storage/packages/7x/index.xml`). See
[The local package repository](../basics/the-local-package-repository.md) and
[Offline installs and mirrors](offline-installs-and-mirrors.md).

## The download settings

Added in 6.0.15 ([changelog](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.15.md), "6 October 2026: the setup's package download").
They apply to the index and to every package the setup downloads.

- **`DownloadAttempts`**: at least 1. An attempt fails on a transfer error, an HTTP status other than 200, an empty
  or truncated file, or an `.ezpkg` that is not gzip data; a failed attempt leaves no file behind.
- **`DownloadRetryDelays[]`**: the wait before attempt 2 is the first value, before attempt 3 the second, and so on;
  the last value is used for all later attempts. With the defaults (3 attempts) the waits are 2 and 5 seconds; the
  10 is used when you raise `DownloadAttempts`.
- **`DownloadTimeout`**: the limit for the whole transfer, with curl and without.
- **`DownloadConnectTimeout`**: the limit for opening the connection, with curl.

An empty value means the built-in default (the same numbers). Failures that cannot get better by waiting, such as a
cache folder that cannot be written, are not retried. What you see when all attempts fail:
[When the package server cannot be reached](when-the-package-server-cannot-be-reached.md).

## Settings in site.ini that go with them

```ini
[ProxySettings]
ProxyServer=
User=
Password=

[FileSettings]
StorageDir=storage
```

`ProxyServer` (with `User` and `Password` when the proxy needs them) is used for the setup's downloads over curl, and
by ezupdate. `StorageDir` is part of the repository path above.

## Overriding the settings

Put changes in `settings/override/package.ini.append.php`, never in `settings/package.ini` itself, which an update
of the kernel replaces:

```ini
<?php /* #?ini charset="utf-8"?

[RepositorySettings]
RemotePackagesIndexURL=https://packages.example.com/6.0/6.0.15
DownloadAttempts=5

*/ ?>
```

The setup wizard runs before any siteaccess exists, so a siteaccess override has no effect on it; use
`settings/override/`. Clear the INI cache after the change (`php bin/php/ezcache.php --clear-tag=ini`). For pointing a
site at your own server, including ezupdate's list and `kickstart.ini`, see
[Pointing a site at your package server](../your-own/pointing-a-site-at-your-package-server.md).
